newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dalian Refrigeration applies to issue B shares.
newsitem.headline: Dalian Refrigeration applies to issue B shares.

text.p: Dalian Refrigeration Equipment Co Ltd has applied to issue US$20 million worth of B shares in 1997, with the number subject to the pricing of the offer, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.

The company has applied to the China Securities Regulatory Commission with the aim of listing the B shares on the Shenzhen bourse next year, he told the China Securities Bulletin, a Hong Kong-based newsletter.
If the issue is approved, the company plans to use the proceeds to expand its main business, he said.
Shenzhen J & A Securities Co Ltd will be lead domestic underwriter, while an international coordinator has yet to be selected, the official said.
Dalian Refrigeration reported net profits of 44.40 million yuan for 1995, up 10.18 percent from 40.30 million yuan in 1994, under Chinese accounting standards.
The firm said in an interim report it had audited after-tax profits of 62.05 million yuan in the first half of 1996, up 163 percent from 23.52 million yuan in the same 1995 period.
The company, which mainly makes refrigerator parts, said the earnings rise was due to good returns from its joint ventures, including its 40 percent-owned Dalian Sanyo Compressor Co Ltd.
